011
012import java.util.Collections;
013import java.util.HashMap;

020/**
021 * The command handler that processing sub commands under QS main command
022 *
023 * @param <T> The required sender class you want, must is the subtype of {@link CommandSender}
024 */
025public interface CommandHandler<T extends CommandSender> {
026
027
028
029  default Shop findShop(final T sender, final CommandParser parser, final int idIndex) {
030
031    final Shop shop = getLookingShop(sender);
032    if(parser.getArgs().size() >= (idIndex + 1)) {
033
034      try {
035
036        final long shopID = Long.parseLong(parser.getArgs().get(idIndex));
037        return QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getShopManager().getShop(shopID);
038      } catch(final Exception ignore) { }
039    }
040
041    return shop;
042  }
043
044  /**
045   * Getting the player now looking shop
046   *
047   * @return The shop that player looking or null if not found
048   *
049   * @throws IllegalStateException if sender is not player
050   */
051  @Nullable
052  default Shop getLookingShop(final T sender) throws IllegalStateException {
053
054    if(sender instanceof final Player player) {
055      final BlockIterator bIt = new BlockIterator(player, 10);
056      while(bIt.hasNext()) {
057        final Block b = bIt.next();
058        final Shop shop = QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getShopManager().getShop(b.getLocation());
059        if(shop == null) {
060          continue;
061        }
062        return shop;
063      }
064      return null;
065    }
066    throw new IllegalStateException("Sender is not player");
067  }
068
069  default @NotNull CompletableFuture<@NotNull List<Shop>> getTaggedShops(final T sender, @NotNull final String tag) {
070
071    if(sender instanceof final Player player) {
072      final UUID tagger = player.getUniqueId();
073      return QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getShopManager().queryTaggedShops(tagger, tag);
074    }
075    throw new IllegalStateException("Sender is not player");
076  }
077
078  /**
079   * Getting the shops by ids
080   *
081   * @param ids The shop ids
082   *
083   * @return The shops
084   */
085  @Nullable
086  default Map<Long, Shop> getShopsByIds(@NotNull final List<Long> ids) {
087
088    final Map<Long, Shop> shops = new HashMap<>();
089    for(final Long id : ids) {
090      shops.put(id, QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getShopManager().getShop(id));
091    }
092    return shops;
093  }
094
095  default void onCommand_Internal(final T sender, @NotNull final String commandLabel, @NotNull final String[] cmdArg) {
096
097    final StringJoiner joiner = new StringJoiner(" ");
098    for(final String s : cmdArg) {
099      joiner.add(s);
100    }
101
102    final CommandParser parser = new CommandParser(joiner.toString(), true);
103    try {
104      onCommand(sender, commandLabel, parser);
105    } catch(final UnsupportedOperationException ignore) {
106      try {
107        onCommand(sender, commandLabel, parser.getArgs().toArray(new String[0]));
108      } catch(final UnsupportedOperationException ignored) {
109
110      }
111    }
112  }
113
114  /**
115   * Calling while command executed by specified sender
116   *
117   * @param sender       The command sender but will automatically convert to specified instance
118   * @param commandLabel The command prefix (/quickshop = qs, /shop = shop)
119   * @param parser       The command parser which include arguments and colon arguments
120   */
121  default void onCommand(final T sender, @NotNull final String commandLabel, @NotNull final CommandParser parser) {
122
123    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This method should be correctly implemented.");
124  }
125
126  /**
127   * Calling while command executed by specified sender
128   *
129   * @param sender       The command sender but will automatically convert to specified instance
130   * @param commandLabel The command prefix (/quickshop = qs, /shop = shop)
131   * @param cmdArgs      The command arguments
132   *
133   * @deprecated This method is deprecated, please use {@link #onCommand(T, String, CommandParser)}
134   * instead.
135   */
136  @Deprecated(since = "4.2.0.0")
137  default void onCommand(final T sender, @NotNull final String commandLabel, @NotNull final String[] cmdArgs) {
138
139    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This method is deprecated, please use onCommand(T sender, @NotNull String commandLabel, @NotNull CommandParser parser) instead.");
140  }
141
142  @Nullable
143  default List<String> onTabComplete_Internal(@NotNull final T sender, @NotNull final String commandLabel, @NotNull final String[] cmdArg) {
144
145    final StringJoiner joiner = new StringJoiner(" ");
146    for(final String s : cmdArg) {
147      joiner.add(s);
148    }
149    final CommandParser parser = new CommandParser(joiner.toString(), false);
150    try {
151      return onTabComplete(sender, commandLabel, parser);
152    } catch(final UnsupportedOperationException ignore) {
153      try {
154        return onTabComplete(sender, commandLabel, parser.getArgs().toArray(new String[0]));
155      } catch(final UnsupportedOperationException ignored) {
156        return Collections.emptyList();
157      }
158    }
159  }
160
161  /**
162   * Calling while sender trying to tab-complete
163   *
164   * @param sender       The command sender but will automatically convert to specified instance
165   * @param commandLabel The command prefix (/quickshop = qs, /shop = shop)
166   * @param parser       The command parser which include arguments and colon arguments
167   *
168   * @return Candidate list
169   */
170  @Nullable
171  default List<String> onTabComplete(@NotNull final T sender, @NotNull final String commandLabel, @NotNull final CommandParser parser) {
172
173    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This method should be correctly implemented.");
174  }
175
176  /**
177   * Calling while sender trying to tab-complete
178   *
179   * @param sender       The command sender but will automatically convert to specified instance
180   * @param commandLabel The command prefix (/quickshop = qs, /shop = shop)
181   * @param cmdArgs      The command arguments
182   *
183   * @return Candidate list
184   *
185   * @deprecated This method is deprecated, please use
186   * {@link #onTabComplete(T, String, CommandParser)} instead.
187   */
188  @Deprecated(since = "4.2.0.0")
189  default List<String> onTabComplete(@NotNull final T sender, @NotNull final String commandLabel, @NotNull final String[] cmdArgs) {
190
191    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This method is deprecated, please use onTabComplete(T sender, @NotNull String commandLabel, @NotNull CommandParser parser) instead.");
192  }
193}
